name: Progressive Career
author: Swofty
description: A Driver Career that starts in any season from 2016 to 2026 as a real driver and moves through the real seasons: each year's cars, liveries, helmets and line-ups, then 2026 from there on.

saves.message: Progressive careers won't load without it.

options.label: Starting season
options.description: The real season a new Progressive career starts in. Each new season moves on a year, up to 2026.

options.label: R&D
options.description: Real life: each season's car brings that year's pace, with no R&D. Hybrid: R&D on top of the year's car, with a per-season budget from the team's real pace. You can change it at any time; it applies to the loaded career.

options.label: Team moves
options.description: Follow your driver's real career from team to team, or choose your team from the offers.

options.label: Season cars and helmets
options.description: Each season also brings that year's cars, liveries and helmets.

options.label: In-season development
options.description: With Real life R&D, every team's car gains or loses pace through the season the way it did in that real season.

options.label: Real team performance
options.description: Every team's R&D performance (Team HQ's vehicle performance comparison, the game's team rankings) follows the season's real order.

options.label: Real driver ratings
options.description: Every season gives each AI driver his real ratings of that year (experience, racecraft, awareness, pace, focus, and the overall they make). Your driver starts a new career with his real ratings of the starting year; after that his ratings are his own.

options.label: Developer: test calendar
options.description: Developer test: makes the Short season length 3 races for every 2026 season, so a season can be simmed to its end quickly. Start a new career after changing it. Leave off.

options.label: Developer: next season now
options.description: Developer test: the next Team HQ of a Progressive career applies the following season's line-ups, cars and looks without racing the season. Turn it off and on again for another season. Leave off.

options.label: 10 teams in 2017-2025
options.description: The seasons 2017 to 2025 race 10 teams and 20 cars, as they really did: Manor's drivers leave the grid at the first Team HQ of 2017, and Cadillac joins with two drivers in 2026. Turn it off to keep an 11th team through those seasons.

options.label: Developer: seat probe
options.description: Developer test: applies data/probe.json seat writes at Team HQ in any Driver Career. Leave off.
